requirements.title: A share can be created with an optional view limit from 1 to 1000; a share created without one behaves as today
Creating a share with a view limit outside 1 to 1000 fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT
Each successful resolve of a share token adds 1 to that share's view count, and an invalid, expired or revoked token counts nothing
Once a share's view count reaches its limit the token returns NOT_FOUND, and 2 racing resolves for the last view never both succeed
Listing a memo's shares returns each share's view count and its view limit when it has one
The web share panel offers no limit, 1 view, 10 views or 100 views next to the expiry choice and sends the choice on create
Each listed share in the panel shows "N of M views" with a limit and "N views" without one, from English locale strings
SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL each get a migration adding the view limit and view count, LATEST.sql matches, and existing shares keep working with no limit and a view count of 0
